messages:
Eli: Quick note 10m sync: were running a short hero + CTA copy sprint for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages next week. Goal: increase qualified demo/webinar signups and split intent by product. whos available to draft variants?
Marin: i'm in. propose two hero frames per product: engineer-first and enterprise-trust. that'll give us signal on tone.
Priya: routing plan: want each CTA to land in a separate HubSpot list so sales can prioritize. also include a small qual question for Dedicated.
Zoe: draft hero lines (short):
- Hosted (eng): "Launch features fast with a managed inference API"
- Hosted (enterprise): "Production-ready hosted inference, no infra required"
- Dedicated (eng): "Dedicated GPU capacity for predictable throughput"
- Dedicated (enterprise): "Reserved GPU pools with SLA-backed latency"
- Private (eng): "Run inference inside your VPC with key control"
- Private (enterprise): "Private deployments with KMS & audit logs"
Eli: nice. CTAs: Hosted -> "Start free trial"; Dedicated -> "Request capacity"; Private -> "Talk to sales". Webinar banner CTA separate: "Save my seat" with its own list.
Priya: HubSpot routing snippet (will implement):
```
hosted -> list: lp_hosted_trial; lead_source=hero_sprint_510000
dedicated -> list: lp_dedicated_inq; lead_source=hero_sprint_510000
private -> list: lp_private_contact; lead_source=hero_sprint_510000
webinar -> list: webinar_hero_sprint; lead_source=hero_sprint_510000_banner
```
Marin: experiment plan: 2 tones x 3 products = 6 variants. run 72 hours evenly, then top 2 continue for 7 days. utm_campaign=hero_sprint_may2026, utm_content=variant_{id}.
Zoe: copy deliverable checklist: headline (<=9 words), one-line subhead, primary CTA label, short CTA microcopy (privacy/trial), 1 feature chip (<=30 chars), optional webinar banner. Keep claims specific.
Eli: timeline: drafts by Mon EOD, staging + tracking by Wed, launch Thu morning. Priya you'll confirm lists + form fields?
Priya: yes. Dedicated qual fields: desired qps, monthly token estimate, preferred region. If token_estimate > 500M map to AE queue.
HookBot: created staging tracking links: https://rwd.ex/track/A1 (hosted), https://rwd.ex/track/B2 (dedicated), https://rwd.ex/track/C3 (private). Will validate on Wed 08:00 PT. :robot_face:
Marin: also add a tiny line under CTA about data: "We only use input for serving; no training." keeps privacy clear.
Zoe: I'll post two tone variants for each product as bullets later today. please keep feedback quick so we can iterate.
Eli: thanks team. keep language plain and testable. reconvene Thu 08:30 PT to review initial data. :sparkles:
